✦ About Me

Hi! I’m a an astronomy graduate student at The Ohio State University. I’m primarily interested in charting the properties and evolution of stars, including the orbits of close-in binaries, the occurrence relation of stellar flares & spots, and the presence of sympathetic flares. My present research is on improving corrections to the saturated stars pipeline of the All-Sky Automated Survey for Supernovae (ASAS-SN) collaboration. I also like to work on the instruments which produce our astronomical data, and am currently characterizing persistence on the iLocater spectrograph.
